svg.title: Global steel emissions: response to medium/high settings

cc:Work.dc:title: Global steel emissions: response to medium/high settings
cc:Work.dc:description: Global steel emissions responses in 2050, with NDC on the left and NDC+LTT on the right. Each medium/high category pairs OMNIA-ENGAGE CE in EU plus partners (left solid blue bar) with OPEN-PROM's corresponding ambition setting (right grey hatched bar). EU-only OMNIA cases are not plotted. Each value is 100 × (setting − reference) / reference in the same model, climate and year. OMNIA uses the pathway's no-CE scenario; OPEN-PROM uses its supplied matching CSV reference. All totals are global; EU+ denotes the 17-region CE adoption area, not the area aggregated. OMNIA selects Emissions|GHG|Industry|Iron and Steel in MtCO2e/yr; OPEN-PROM selects Emissions|CO2|Energy|Demand|Industry|Iron and Steel in Mt CO2/yr. OPEN-PROM has no steel-specific process-emissions or GHG total. The different gas and accounting scopes are not harmonised by percentages. The medium/high labels do not establish equivalent interventions or adoption geography. Capture is not subtracted again. Markers identify observed endpoints, including zero; missing values remain gaps. The two panels share a percentage scale. Absolute quantities and references remain in the source CSV, and unplotted EU-only cases and other years are explicitly marked as context. OMNIA missing activity = zero (provisional). Medium/high labels do not establish equivalent policies.
